clue.text: Financial officer.A teller?

definitions.meaning: a clerk who keeps a firm's books and records of money
a teller counts, and one who renders accounts is in a playful sense a teller of them

explanation.definitionFit: A bookkeeping employee handles a company's money records, and a person who counts or tells is playfully one who accounts.

clue.text: Train as craft journeyman

indicators.note: to craft is to work into a new shape, so these letters are refashioned

explanation.surface: Someone trains to master a craft before becoming a qualified journeyman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'craft' looks like a noun but is the signal to rearrange TRAIN AS.
explanation.definitionFit: A journeyman is a skilled tradesperson, synonymous with a craftsperson or artisan.

clue.text: Imprison for swindle and add financial penalty

parts.note: a con is a swindle or trick
a fine is a monetary penalty

explanation.surface: A fraudster is jailed for a swindle and also ordered to pay a penalty.
explanation.definitionFit: To shut someone in, as in prison, is a synonym for imprisoning them.

clue.text: Baggage transports

definitions.meaning: an informal word for personal belongings or luggage
a trap is a light two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is informal belongings; the other is small horse-drawn carriages used for getting about.

clue.text: Dishy chap seen at all the best functions?

definitions.text: Dishy chap seen at all the best functions?

parts.words: Dishy chap seen at all the best functions?
parts.note: dishy here means serving dishes rather than handsome: the man who supplies food at parties

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who provides food at functions is literally the person bringing the dishes to every event.

clue.text: Greek girl to vote top painter into office

parts.note: to elect is to vote someone into office
RA, Royal Academician, a leading British painter

explanation.surface: A Greek woman campaigns to vote a famous artist into public office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into office' completes the sense of electing and gives no letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Electra is the daughter of Agamemnon in Greek myth and tragedy, so a girl from Greek legend.

clue.text: Where we can take our pick of the food, being in bed

definitions.text: Where we can take our pick of the food, being in bed

parts.words: Where we can take our pick of the food, being in bed
parts.note: the bed is a garden bed, not a sleeping one, and picking means harvesting vegetables

explanation.definitionFit: A plot near the house where vegetables and herbs grow in beds for picking and cooking.

clue.text: Bill's short, not getting rise in London

parts.note: a/c, short for account, is a bill

indicators.note: rising means the word not is read upwards, i.e. backwards

explanation.surface: Someone complains their bill was cut short and they are not getting a pay rise in London.
explanation.definitionFit: Acton is a district of west London, so the clue's place reference fits.

clue.text: Tent or cabin in ruins, old man?

indicators.note: something in ruins is wrecked and broken up, so these letters are scattered and rebuilt

explanation.surface: An old man looks at his tent or cabin lying wrecked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' belongs to the fodder (TENT OR CABIN IN, thirteen letters); 'ruins' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A man from pre-Roman Britain is literally an old inhabitant of the island, the question mark flagging the example.

clue.text: Mantrap the heartless set in the living room

indicators.note: set in the sense of arranged or placed in order, so these letters are rearranged
losing its heart means the middle letter of the word the is removed

explanation.surface: Someone has placed a man-trap in the living room for an intruder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' makes TE from THE; 'set' rearranges MANTRAP plus TE.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat or set of rooms where people live is loosely a living room or rooms.

clue.text: Mean to declare on time

parts.note: to aver is to assert or declare
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone intends to make their declaration on schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: The mean of a set of numbers is its arithmetical average.

clue.text: Indian group, in '49, founded a community in Spain

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a caste is a hereditary social class in India
IL is an informal Roman-numeral form of 49

explanation.surface: Pioneers from India in 1849 settled a community in Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: IL for 49 is loose Roman notation (strictly XLIX).
explanation.definitionFit: Castile is a historic region and kingdom of central Spain, now an autonomous community.

clue.text: A sentence suffered on the rack?

definitions.meaning: the rack pulled victims' bodies longer

explanation.definitionFit: Slang uses this word for time in jail, and the rack was a torture device that elongated limbs.

clue.text: Computer in the Bond organisation?

parts.note: not James Bond but Premium Bonds, a British savings lottery whose winners are drawn by a machine

explanation.definitionFit: The Electronic Random Number Indicator Equipment picks winning British Premium Bond numbers.

clue.text: Discover Cartesian order

indicators.note: putting the letters in a new order rearranges them

explanation.surface: Uncover the logic of Descartes's philosophical system.
explanation.definitionFit: To find out for certain is a synonym of discovering a fact.

clue.text: Preserve musical work for a great star

parts.note: to can food is to preserve it in tins
an opus is a numbered musical composition

explanation.surface: A recording of a composition is kept for posterity as a tribute to a celebrated performer.
explanation.definitionFit: Canopus is the second brightest star in the night sky, so a great star literally.

clue.text: On it, we're restricted to the ring, it turns out

indicators.note: turning out means the letters are reorganised into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A circus performer finds they are confined to the ring after all.
explanation.definitionFit: Keeping someone under close control is idiomatically holding them on a firm leash or bridle.

clue.text: A glum or wretched look? Quite the opposite

indicators.note: wretched suggests something in a sorry state, so these letters are knocked into a new form

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a person looks gloomy, and is told they look the reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: Allure and attractive charm is the opposite of a gloomy, miserable appearance.

clue.text: Shot by arbitrator? Bother!

definitions.meaning: a mediator is a shooter of difficulties, so difficulty is what gets shot
bother as a noun means difficulty or fuss

explanation.definitionFit: A troubleshooter mediates disputes, and bother means difficulty or inconvenience.

clue.text: Food that went to waste in the Bible

definitions.text: Food that went to waste in the Bible

parts.words: Food that went to waste in the Bible
parts.note: in Exodus the miraculous food from heaven bred worms and rotted if kept overnight

explanation.definitionFit: The miraculous food that fed the Israelites in the wilderness went bad if hoarded.

clue.text: Sandyland the book-binder

definitions.meaning: a north African country with much desert
fine goatskin leather used in binding books

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a north African kingdom bordering the Sahara and a soft leather prized for book covers.

clue.text: A number turn up to dance and sport with the ladies

indicators.note: turning up a down entry means reading the word backwards

parts.note: ten is a number
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: Several people show up to a dance and to games played with women.
explanation.definitionFit: Netball is a team game traditionally played chiefly by women and girls.

clue.text: Computer-generated info about a detour

indicators.note: about here means turned around, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A satnav produces data concerning a diversion.
explanation.definitionFit: Data displayed or printed by a computer is called its output display.

clue.text: Flower; brown with some yellow tips

parts.note: tan is a light brown colour

indicators.note: the tips of the words some and yellow are their first letters

explanation.surface: A flower described as brown with some yellow at its petal tips.
explanation.definitionFit: Tansy is a plant with button-like yellow blooms, so it is a flower.

clue.text: Stolen Corsair 500

parts.note: a corsair is a pirate
D is 500 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A list entry notes a stolen Corsair, as if a car model, numbered 500.
explanation.definitionFit: Copied or taken unlawfully, as with pirated goods, means stolen.

clue.text: Robots men programmed for Band Aid!

indicators.note: robots that are programmed are set up anew, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Robot musicians are programmed to play for a charity concert.
explanation.definitionFit: Brass instruments are an aid to a band, playfully taking the brand of plaster as a musical group.

clue.text: A lot of shops in Fetter Lane, perhaps

definitions.text: A lot of shops in Fetter Lane, perhaps

parts.words: A lot of shops in Fetter Lane, perhaps
parts.note: a group of shops under one owner, and a fetter is a shackle; Fetter Lane is a London street

explanation.definitionFit: A group of branch stores and a shackle of linked rings share this name.

clue.text: Where we learn all about market-gardening?

definitions.text: Where we learn all about market-gardening?

parts.words: Where we learn all about market-gardening?
parts.note: a plant nursery is a gardening place, but this nursery teaches young children

explanation.definitionFit: A kindergarten for very young children, punning on a horticultural nursery.
